messages.content: Write a comprehensive, deeply technical 8-section architectural whitepaper on Enterprise AI FinOps, Real-Time Token Metering, and Deterministic Stream Governance. Section 1: Distributed Token Ledger Topologies and Atomic Quota Enforcement. Section 2: Asynchronous Stream Interception and Sub-Millisecond Kill-Switch Mechanics. Section 3: Cryptographic Mandate Translation (JWT to AP2) and Zero-Trust Identity Binding. Section 4: Time-Window Chunk Coalescing and Application-Layer VCR Replay Determinism. Section 5: Multi-Tenant Cost Attribution, Dynamic Tier Fallback, and Budget Circuit Breakers. Section 6: Edge Caching, Semantic Routing, and Pre-Flight Payload Sanitization. Section 7: Failure Modes, Network Partition Recovery, and Idempotent Billing Reconciliation. Section 8: Full Reference Architecture and Production Deployment Checklist. Provide exhaustive explanations, concrete architectural trade-offs, and detailed step-by-step walkthroughs for every single section without summarizing or skipping any details.
